_note: Corrections to the extracted Chapter H listings (data/rulebook/vehicles.json), applied every time the table loads, so a fix ships with a normal deploy and survives re-running scripts/extract_vehicle_listings.py. Each 'vehicles'/'guns' entry matches rows by exact name (and nationality, if given) and sets the listed fields; give a reason. 'add_vehicles'/'add_guns' append whole rows the extractor misses (same fields as vehicles.json). Example: {"name": "M3A1", "nationality": "UN Forces", "set": {"armor": "partial", "hull_front": 0, "hull_side": 0}, "reason": "AF misread"}.
